transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Thanks for seeing me. Um, well... I guess what brings me in is, I hardly eat right anymore. I mean, I don't want to make a big fuss out of it, it's probably nothing, but... some days it's just coffee and maybe a little piece of bread. I did notice my pants are hanging kind of loose on me lately. Is... is that the right kind of thing to tell you? I just want to make sure I'm answering right.
Is it that you're not feeling hungry or is there another reason you're not eating as much as you used to?

Um... yeah, like I was saying, I just... I don't really get hungry much at all. I hope it's okay that I brought it up, I know it's probably not a huge deal. I don't want you to think I'm doing it on purpose or anything, like trying to be difficult or starve myself. It's just... food doesn't really sound good to me right now. So I just stick to the coffee. Does... does that answer what you were asking? I want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Are you trying to lose weight?

Oh, no, no sir. I'm definitely not trying to lose weight. I hope it didn't sound like I was doing some kind of crazy diet or... or doing it on purpose to be difficult. I really just don't have the stomach for much food right now. 

I know I probably should be eating better, and I can try to force something down if you want me to. I don't want you to think I'm neglecting myself on purpose or anything. Did... did that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answer.
Have you lost weight without trying to?

Yes, sir, I guess I have. Um, like I mentioned a minute ago about my pants fitting all loose now... I definitely didn't mean for it to happen. It's just from, you know, only managing to get down some coffee and maybe a piece of bread most days. 

I really hope I'm not making things difficult by letting that happen, or making you worry. I can try to get a belt or something so I look a little more put together. Is... is that what you were looking for? I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions right and being helpful.
Do you feel sad or anxious when you think about eating?

Oh, no sir. It doesn't make me sad or... or nervous or anything like that. It's not like I get upset thinking about a meal. I just... my stomach just doesn't want it, I guess. 

I hope that makes sense. I really don't want to sound like I'm making a big fuss over it or anything, it's just that I don't feel much of an urge for it. Is... is that a normal way to feel? I hope I'm explaining it right for you, I just want to be as helpful as I can.
Have you noticed a decrease in interest in activities you usually enjoy?

Well, sir... I really don't want to sound lazy or anything, and I know I should be keeping myself busy. But, um, I guess I have slowed down a bit with my hobbies. 

I used to really like walking by the lake, and, you know, working on my little model kits. But lately... they just sit there on the table, and I look at them like they belong to somebody else. I'm not ignoring them on purpose, I promise. I just... I can't seem to get into them right now. 

I can try harder to pick them back up if you think that would be better for me? I don't want you to think I'm just sitting around doing nothing. Does... does that answer what you were asking? I just hope I'm giving you the right kind of answer.
Do you often feel tired?

Well, sir... I guess I have been a little more tired than usual. I really hate to admit it, because I know I should be pulling my weight and keeping active. I don't want you to think I'm just letting myself go or anything like that. 

But, um, lately... even just doing small things, like taking out the trash or even coming down here to the clinic today... it feels like it takes so much out of me. It's almost like my arms and legs are full of wet sand, you know? Just heavy. 

I'm really sorry if that sounds like I'm complaining. I know people work hard all day and get tired, and here I am tired from just taking out the garbage. I can try to push through it more if you think I should. Is... is it okay that I feel that way? I hope I'm giving you the right information.
How much weight would you say you've lost since you first noticed you weren't eating as much?

Well, sir... I'm not exactly sure of the exact number of pounds. I really hope it's okay that I don't know for sure, I just don't have a scale at the house to check. 

But, um... I do know my pants are hanging pretty loose on me lately. I've had to pull my belt a lot tighter just to keep them up. I just... I hardly eat right anymore, I guess. Some days it is really just coffee and maybe a piece of bread. 

I really don't want you to think I'm starving myself on purpose or trying to be difficult, I promise I'm not. I can try to force myself to eat a little more if you think I need to put the weight back on. I want to do whatever you think is best. Is... is that the kind of information you were looking for? I'm sorry I didn't have an exact number for you.
Have you felt this way about your hobbies for most of the day, every day, or does it come and go?

Well, sir... I guess it's pretty much all the time now. Every day, really. 

Like I said before about the model kits and the lake... I wake up and I see the kits sitting there, and I just... I feel like they're not even mine anymore. And that feeling just stays with me all day long. It doesn't really go away. 

I know I should try to snap out of it, and I really don't want to sound like I'm just making excuses to not do things. I'm sorry if it sounds like I'm just giving up on my hobbies. I can try to force myself to work on them a little bit every day if you think that would show I'm trying harder. Does... does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it right for you.
Do you feel guilty or worthless about not being able to enjoy your hobbies like you used to?

Well, sir... I guess I do feel pretty bad about it. I don't want to sound like I'm throwing a pity party or anything, I know people have real problems. But... yeah. 

It's not just the hobbies, really. It's... well, I lost my job a while back. And now my family, my relatives, they have to help me out. I just feel like I'm no good, you know? Like a burden. I don't want you to think I'm not grateful for their help, because I am. I really am. 

But I just sit there and... I replay every little mistake I've ever made in my head. Over and over. Like I just ruined everything for myself and everyone else. I know I shouldn't think that way, and I'm really trying not to be so negative. I can try to focus on the positive more if you think that would help. Is it... is it normal to feel that way when you're not working? I hope I'm not making too big a deal out of it.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Well, sir... I guess it's been a little while now. I really hope you don't think I'm just dragging my feet or not trying hard enough to get better, but... well, this whole depressed spell has been hanging over me for about five months now. 

I know that's a really long time to be down like this, and I'm sorry I haven't been able to just shake it off sooner. I really have been trying to keep my chin up, I promise. Is... is it okay that it's been going on for that long? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right timeline, I don't want to mess up your notes or anything.
Do you find yourself moving or speaking more slowly than you used to?

Well, sir... I guess I have been a little sluggish lately. I don't want you to think I'm just being lazy or not trying to keep up, but... my family, they've mentioned it a few times. They said it's like I'm walking through mud or something. 

And... well, sometimes when people talk to me, it just takes me a minute to get my thoughts together. Even for just a simple question, I might take a long time to answer. I know I should probably be sharper, and I'm really sorry if I'm talking too slow for you today. I'm trying my best to keep up with your questions. Am I... am I doing okay so far? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
Do you still enjoy things that you used to find pleasurable?

Well, sir... I guess I've kind of fallen out of habit with some of my hobbies. I really hope you don't think I'm just giving up on things, because I know how important it is to stay active. But... yeah. 

I used to really like walking by the lake, you know? Just getting some fresh air. And I had these little model kits I'd work on. But lately... well, they just sit there. I look at them, and it's almost like they belong to somebody else. I just can't seem to find the spark for them right now. I know I should probably force myself to get back into it, and I can definitely try harder if you think that's what I need to do. Does that... does that make sense? I hope I'm not sounding too negative about it.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or wanting to be dead?

Oh, no sir... I promise I haven't been thinking anything like that. I really hope I didn't make you worry that I was... you know, that far gone. 

I know I've been pretty down lately, and I'm sorry if I made it sound earlier like I was totally giving up, but I definitely don't want to be dead. I wouldn't do anything to hurt myself, I swear. I just want to get back on my feet and be useful again. I hope it's okay that I don't have those kinds of thoughts... I'm really trying my best to hang in there and do what I'm supposed to do. Is that... is that a good thing to hear? I just don't want you to think I'm keeping anything from you.
Do you feel like you're resting or sleeping more than usual?

Well, sir... I guess my sleep has been a little off lately, but I don't want you to think I'm just laying around in bed all day being lazy. I know I need to be up and doing things. 

But... well, honestly, it's been kind of hard to get a good night's rest. Sometimes I just lie there for hours, you know, just staring at the wall, trying so hard to fall asleep. And then other times, I'll wake up way before the sun even comes up, and I just can't get back to sleep no matter how hard I try. Even when I do manage to get some shut-eye, I still wake up feeling pretty worn out. I know I should be doing a better job of keeping a regular schedule, and I'm really trying to get it under control. I hope it's okay that I'm struggling with this right now... does that sound like something we can fix? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Would you say you've lost more than 5% of your body weight over the past month?

Well, sir... I guess I have lost a little bit of weight, but I really hope you don't think I'm doing it on purpose or starving myself or anything like that. I know I need to keep my strength up. 

It's just... well, lately I hardly eat right anymore. Some days it's just coffee and maybe a piece of bread. I just don't have much of an appetite, and I don't want to force it and make myself sick, you know? But I did notice my pants are hanging kind of loose on me now. I'm not exactly sure if it's been five percent of my weight, I haven't been on a scale to check... I'm sorry if I don't have the exact number for you. I can definitely try to start eating more if you think that's what I should be doing. I want to make sure I'm taking care of myself the way you want me to. Does that... does that answer your question okay?
Would you say your feelings of sadness or worthlessness are present nearly every day?

Well, sir... I guess I have been feeling a bit down quite a lot lately. I hope you don't think I'm just sitting around throwing a pity party for myself or anything. I really try to keep a positive attitude, I promise I do. 

But... well, honestly, most days I wake up and there's just this... this heavy, empty feeling right here in my chest. It just sort of sits there. It feels like... like nothing good is waiting for me out there, so I just kind of want to keep my head down and stay out of everyone's way. I know I shouldn't feel like that, and I'm really sorry if that makes it sound like I'm not trying hard enough to be happy. I am trying, I really am. I hope it's alright that I feel this way right now... is that normal for what I'm going through? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture so you can help me get back to being myself.
Would you say your feelings of sadness are interfering with your ability to function in daily life?

Well, sir... I guess things have been a little harder to keep up with lately, but I really don't want you to think I'm just giving up or expecting everyone to do things for me. I know a man my age should be taking care of his own business, and I really do try to handle what I can. 

But... well, honestly, since things got so bad with how I've been feeling, I've had to lean on my family a bit more than I'd like. I've needed my relatives to help out with some money here and there, and they've been giving me rides and helping me sort through paperwork. I'm just not keeping up with my basic errands the way I used to... going to the store or paying bills just feels like climbing a mountain right now. I know I should be doing it all myself, and I feel terrible putting it on them. I'm really trying to get back on my feet so I don't have to be a burden. I hope it's okay to admit that I need help right now... does that make sense to you? I just want to make sure I'm doing the right thing by telling you this.
Would you say your feelings of sadness are severely impairing your ability to function in daily life?

Well, sir... I know we just touched on this a little bit, and I really don't want to sound like a broken record or like I'm complaining too much. I hope you don't think I'm just sitting back and letting everything fall apart on purpose. I'm really trying my best to keep it together, I promise. 

But... yeah, I guess if I'm being completely honest, it is pretty severe right now. Like I mentioned, since all this got so bad, I've had to ask my relatives to help out with money, and they've been driving me places and helping me figure out my paperwork. And I'm just... I'm really not keeping up with my basic errands anymore, like going to the grocery store or the post office. It just feels so overwhelming, and I feel awful that I can't just do it myself like a normal person. I know I should be doing better, and I'm really sorry if it sounds like I'm just giving up. I want to get back to doing everything on my own, just like you'd want me to. Is it okay that I'm struggling this much right now? I hope I'm not disappointing you by needing so much help.

target_item.reason: The doctor is asking if I move or speak more slowly than I used to, which corresponds to psychomotor changes (retardation).

patient.answer:
Well, sir... I guess I have been a little sluggish lately. I don't want you to think I'm just being lazy or not trying to keep up, but... my family, they've mentioned it a few times. They said it's like I'm walking through mud or something. 

And... well, sometimes when people talk to me, it just takes me a minute to get my thoughts together. Even for just a simple question, I might take a long time to answer. I know I should probably be sharper, and I'm really sorry if I'm talking too slow for you today. I'm trying my best to keep up with your questions. Am I... am I doing okay so far? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.

doctor.question: Do you still enjoy things that you used to find pleasurable?

target_item.name: Loss_of_Interest
target_item.manifestation: I used to like walking by the lake and working on my little model kits, but now they just sit there and I look at them like they belong to somebody else.
target_item.reason: The doctor is asking if I still enjoy things I used to find pleasurable, which directly corresponds to the symptom of loss of interest.

patient.answer:
Well, sir... I guess I've kind of fallen out of habit with some of my hobbies. I really hope you don't think I'm just giving up on things, because I know how important it is to stay active. But... yeah. 

I used to really like walking by the lake, you know? Just getting some fresh air. And I had these little model kits I'd work on. But lately... well, they just sit there. I look at them, and it's almost like they belong to somebody else. I just can't seem to find the spark for them right now. I know I should probably force myself to get back into it, and I can definitely try harder if you think that's what I need to do. Does that... does that make sense? I hope I'm not sounding too negative about it.

doctor.question: Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or wanting to be dead?

target_item.reason: The doctor is asking about suicidal ideation or thoughts of death, which is not included in my symptom profile.

patient.answer:
Oh, no sir... I promise I haven't been thinking anything like that. I really hope I didn't make you worry that I was... you know, that far gone. 

I know I've been pretty down lately, and I'm sorry if I made it sound earlier like I was totally giving up, but I definitely don't want to be dead. I wouldn't do anything to hurt myself, I swear. I just want to get back on my feet and be useful again. I hope it's okay that I don't have those kinds of thoughts... I'm really trying my best to hang in there and do what I'm supposed to do. Is that... is that a good thing to hear? I just don't want you to think I'm keeping anything from you.

target_item.reason: The doctor is asking about changes in sleep, specifically sleeping or resting more than usual, which corresponds to the Sleep Disturbance symptom.

patient.answer:
Well, sir... I guess my sleep has been a little off lately, but I don't want you to think I'm just laying around in bed all day being lazy. I know I need to be up and doing things. 

But... well, honestly, it's been kind of hard to get a good night's rest. Sometimes I just lie there for hours, you know, just staring at the wall, trying so hard to fall asleep. And then other times, I'll wake up way before the sun even comes up, and I just can't get back to sleep no matter how hard I try. Even when I do manage to get some shut-eye, I still wake up feeling pretty worn out. I know I should be doing a better job of keeping a regular schedule, and I'm really trying to get it under control. I hope it's okay that I'm struggling with this right now... does that sound like something we can fix? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.

doctor.intent: determine the presence of significant weight loss

target_item.name: Weight_Appetite_Change

patient.answer:
Well, sir... I guess I have lost a little bit of weight, but I really hope you don't think I'm doing it on purpose or starving myself or anything like that. I know I need to keep my strength up. 

It's just... well, lately I hardly eat right anymore. Some days it's just coffee and maybe a piece of bread. I just don't have much of an appetite, and I don't want to force it and make myself sick, you know? But I did notice my pants are hanging kind of loose on me now. I'm not exactly sure if it's been five percent of my weight, I haven't been on a scale to check... I'm sorry if I don't have the exact number for you. I can definitely try to start eating more if you think that's what I should be doing. I want to make sure I'm taking care of myself the way you want me to. Does that... does that answer your question okay?

doctor.intent: determine the severity of depressive episode
doctor.question: Would you say your feelings of sadness or worthlessness are present nearly every day?

target_item.name: Depressed_Mood
target_item.manifestation: Most days I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest, like nothing good is waiting for me and I just want to keep my head down.
target_item.reason: The doctor is asking about the frequency of feelings of sadness, which directly corresponds to depressed mood.

patient.answer:
Well, sir... I guess I have been feeling a bit down quite a lot lately. I hope you don't think I'm just sitting around throwing a pity party for myself or anything. I really try to keep a positive attitude, I promise I do. 

But... well, honestly, most days I wake up and there's just this... this heavy, empty feeling right here in my chest. It just sort of sits there. It feels like... like nothing good is waiting for me out there, so I just kind of want to keep my head down and stay out of everyone's way. I know I shouldn't feel like that, and I'm really sorry if that makes it sound like I'm not trying hard enough to be happy. I am trying, I really am. I hope it's alright that I feel this way right now... is that normal for what I'm going through? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture so you can help me get back to being myself.

doctor.intent: determine the severity of depressive episode
doctor.question: Would you say your feelings of sadness are interfering with your ability to function in daily life?

target_item.name: Functional Impairment
target_item.manifestation: Since this got bad, I have needed my relatives to help with money, rides, and paperwork, and I am not keeping up with basic errands the way I used to.
target_item.reason: The doctor is asking about whether the feelings of sadness are interfering with my ability to function in daily life, which directly maps to functional impairment.

patient.answer:
Well, sir... I guess things have been a little harder to keep up with lately, but I really don't want you to think I'm just giving up or expecting everyone to do things for me. I know a man my age should be taking care of his own business, and I really do try to handle what I can. 

But... well, honestly, since things got so bad with how I've been feeling, I've had to lean on my family a bit more than I'd like. I've needed my relatives to help out with some money here and there, and they've been giving me rides and helping me sort through paperwork. I'm just not keeping up with my basic errands the way I used to... going to the store or paying bills just feels like climbing a mountain right now. I know I should be doing it all myself, and I feel terrible putting it on them. I'm really trying to get back on my feet so I don't have to be a burden. I hope it's okay to admit that I need help right now... does that make sense to you? I just want to make sure I'm doing the right thing by telling you this.

target_item.name: Functional Impairment

I want to get back to doing everything on my own, just like you'd want me to. Is it okay that I'm struggling this much right now? I hope I'm not disappointing you by needing so much help.
